info.title: RentMate API
info.description: Agent-controlled transport. Money is integer LKR minor units. Agents/drivers need APPROVED status for business operations. All errors are {error:{code,message,details?}}; success is {data:...}. Driver responses omit total, deposit, commission and private documents. Tourist responses omit driver phone/payout/commission. Admin private reads require a reason and are audited.
